analysis_md:
解析：

由题意知 $\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$，即

$$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=0$$
search_text:
单连通域 $G$ 内的函数 $P(x,y),Q(x,y)$ 有一阶连续偏导数，曲线积分 $\int_C Pdx+Qdy$ 在 $G$ 内与路径无关的充要条件是 $G$ 内恒有（ ） $\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}=0$ $\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=0$ $\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=0$ $\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}=0$ 解析：

由题意知 $\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$，即

$$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=0$$
